chapter: New Orleans bands, Louis and the Lyric
title: Fletcher Henderson's telegram and Louis leaving for King Oliver
summary: Louis showed Zutty Fletcher Henderson's telegram and refused to go without him; Fletcher had Kaiser Marshall. Louis later left for King Oliver, and Buster Bailey got him the Henderson job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Oh man, good. Very good. But Fletcher Henderson sent for Louis and Louis showed me the telegram that Fletcher wanted Louis to join him in New York. And old Louis told me, he said, I'm not going if you don't go.

So we went to the telegraph office and we sent Fletcher a night letter, see? Explaining everything to him. And that's when Fletcher wrote back and he said that he had had a drummer that he had had so long which was Kaiser Marshall. And I really didn't want Louis to draw me on Fletcher then you know.
Louis said, well man, you've got rhythm, all you need is to play that rhythm and that's it. I said, no, but that fell through anyway because Fletcher didn't want to change …….
But this was before Louis had been to Chicago even?
Yes.
Yes.
Yes, well I mean, it was kind of a big step.
Yes, this is before he joined
King Oliver.
Who did you get then Zutty after Louis left? On trumpet?
Who did he get?
I asked Zutty who did he replace.
I can't remember.
Who, Fletcher?
For Louis when Louis left him.
When Louis left. Because Louis told me, he said, man, he said, King Oliver sent for me this time. He said, man, I'm going. He says, because Dodds is playing drums.
Yes, but what I mean when he went with Fletcher. When he left you and went with Fletcher.
Well no, he didn't leave me. He only left me to go to King Oliver.
King Oliver.
Yes, because he left King Oliver to go with Fletcher.
Yes, Buster Bailey got him that job with Fletcher Henderson.
